description: Load a benchmark corpus case, re-run the matching design wrapper with its inputs, and diff computed sample_size_total / events_total against expected within the case's tolerance.

family.description: Benchmark family directory name under benchmarks/ (e.g. 'fixed-superiority', 'group-sequential', 'tte-nph').

id.description: Case ID = YAML filename without extension, e.g. '1997_CAPTURE_abciximab'.

tool.description: Override the design tool to dispatch. If omitted, inferred from case metadata.

name: validate_against_benchmark
